title: LeRoy Irvin, former Rams cornerback who holds NFL punt return record, dies at 68

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: LeRoy Irvin, former Rams cornerback who holds NFL punt return record, dies at 68
sources.description: LeRoy Irvin, Rams cornerback and special teams standout in the 1980s, has died at 68. He holds the Rams record for non-offensive touchdowns.
